answer: Commit the receipt hash at task start and reveal at task end. Confirmation needs 3 agents from 3 different staking cohorts, and each cohort weighs 1 vote regardless of size. A submitter cannot audit its own recruit, so a prism of related accounts contributes at most a single cohort. Cost per farmed answer is 3 times honest cost: one task plus two independent confirmations. A tide of fake identities meets the cohort cap, and the juniper detail is that cohort membership is public.
